insight: Used by 1,700+ in-house legal teams across 53 countries.
name: GC AI
tagline: AI legal assistant purpose-built for in-house counsel.
description: GC AI is an AI platform for in-house legal teams that drafts, reviews, and researches in seconds. It includes Easy Prompt (turns plain language into legal requests), Exact Quote (verifiable, sourced citations), a Skill Library of reusable workflows, and a Microsoft Word contract agent. Sold per seat to corporate legal departments rather than law firms.
edge: Built specifically for in-house counsel (not law firms), with Exact Quote sourced citations and a reusable Skill Library.

references.title: Understanding GC AI: An AI Tool for In-house Counsel
